en: No recorded deviations: 0 gate rejections, 0 false claims, 0 interventions, 0 harness recoveries, 0 troubleshooting steps on the direct stack.
The Moonshot Tier 0 rate limit, a design-time risk, never occurred.

The model was in its third week after release, so serving quality may vary.
